newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen remains ask-only after TSE move.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen remains ask-only after TSE move.

text.p: Shares of Gajoen Kanko KK continued to be ask-only on Wednesday afternoon as the Tokyo Stock Exchange's announcement that its shares have been placed under surveillance kept on inviting a rush of sales orders, traders said.
The hotel operator's share price was ask-only at 122 yen at 0444 GMT, against Tuesday's ask-only price at 162 yen.
The TSE said before the market opened on Tuesday that it would place Gajoen Kanko under surveillance until it is decided whether the firm will delist from the TSE.
Gajoen Kanko said late on Monday that it had overdue taxes totalling about 13 billion yen, including taxes in arrears.
